description: This file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget named SearchTab, which provides a user interface for searching recipes with filtering options. It interacts with RecipeProvider and FavoritesProvider to fetch and display recipes, and navigates to a recipe detail screen.

classes.name: SearchTab
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a search interface for recipes, including filtering options.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget, returning an instance of _SearchTabState.

methods.name: _SearchTabState
methods.description: Internal state class managing the search input, filters, and UI updates.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the search tab, including search bar, loading indicator, message, and grid of recipe cards.

methods.name: _search
methods.description: Executes a search by querying the RecipeProvider with current search text and selected filters.
